description: API throughput, latency percentiles, error rates, and rate limiting for RastaFinanças

targets.rawSql:
WITH deltas AS (
  SELECT date_bin($__interval, time) AS time, route, method, status_code,
    counter - LAG(counter) OVER (PARTITION BY route, method, status_code ORDER BY time) AS delta,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (time - LAG(time) OVER (PARTITION BY route, method, status_code ORDER BY time))) AS dt
  FROM http_requests_total
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
)
SELECT time, route, method, AVG(delta / dt) AS value
FROM deltas
WHERE dt > 0 AND delta >= 0
GROUP BY time, route, method
ORDER BY time

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    date_bin($__interval, time) AS bucket,
    route, method,
    "5" AS b5, "10" AS b10, "25" AS b25, "50" AS b50, "100" AS b100,
    "250" AS b250, "500" AS b500, "1000" AS b1000, "2500" AS b2500, "+Inf" AS binf,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY date_bin($__interval, time), route, method ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn
  FROM http_request_duration_ms
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
)
SELECT bucket AS time, route, method,
  CASE
    WHEN binf = 0 THEN 0
    WHEN b5 >= binf * 0.5 THEN 5
    WHEN b10 >= binf * 0.5 THEN 10
    WHEN b25 >= binf * 0.5 THEN 25
    WHEN b50 >= binf * 0.5 THEN 50
    WHEN b100 >= binf * 0.5 THEN 100
    WHEN b250 >= binf * 0.5 THEN 250
    WHEN b500 >= binf * 0.5 THEN 500
    WHEN b1000 >= binf * 0.5 THEN 1000
    WHEN b2500 >= binf * 0.5 THEN 2500
    ELSE 5000
  END AS value
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY time

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT route, method, url, status_code, counter,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY route, method, url, status_code ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn
  FROM http_requests_total
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
),
last_vals AS (SELECT * FROM latest WHERE rn = 1)
SELECT
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(counter), 0) FROM last_vals WHERE status_code LIKE '5%') * 100.0
  / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(counter) FROM last_vals), 0) AS value

WITH deltas AS (
  SELECT date_bin($__interval, time) AS time, route, method, status_code,
    counter - LAG(counter) OVER (PARTITION BY route, method, status_code ORDER BY time) AS delta
  FROM http_requests_total
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND status_code LIKE '4%'
)
SELECT time, route, SUM(delta) AS value
FROM deltas
WHERE delta >= 0
GROUP BY time, route
ORDER BY time

WITH deltas AS (
  SELECT date_bin($__interval, time) AS time,
    counter - LAG(counter) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS delta
  FROM rasta_rate_limit_hits_total
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
)
SELECT time, SUM(delta) AS value
FROM deltas
WHERE delta >= 0
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time
